title: Lost Mary Nera15K Grape Berry Prefilled Vape Pods
description: The Grape Berry Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pod blends juicy Grape with mixed Berry for a sweet yet tangy flavour profile. The smooth grape base is lifted by berry notes that add depth and sharpness, resulting in a layered vape that’s fruity, refreshing, and well-rounded. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 15ml Refill Pod that automatically replenishes the pod as you vape. Together, they deliver up to 15,000 puffs depending on usage, with no need for manual refilling or coil changes. Equipped with a 0.6ohm mesh coil, the pod ensures vibrant flavour and smooth vapour output every time. Made exclusively for the Lost Mary Nera30K Prefilled Pod Kit, setup is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill pod into place and you’re ready to continue. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
